info.title: ResponseMatch API
info.summary: Human-in-the-loop emergency dispatch decision support (IBM Z Datathon 2026).
info.description:
Authoritative contract for ResponseMatch Live, Planning and Insights.

**Decision support only.** The API never issues real dispatch orders; any resulting unit assignment is a simulated action. All operational data is synthetic or simulated. Not CJIS-certified, HIPAA-compliant, or production-ready.

Conventions: timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC; list endpoints use cursor pagination (`limit`, `cursor`) and `sort`; mutating endpoints that would be harmful if repeated require `Idempotency-Key`; entities carry `version` for optimistic concurrency; ML predictions, deterministic rules, optimizer output and human decisions are kept in separate fields/records.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Subscribe only to these event types.

parameters.name: lastEventId
parameters.description: Fallback for clients that cannot set headers (e.g. native EventSource polyfills).

200.description: text/event-stream. Each frame: `id: <EventEnvelope.id>`, `event: <type>`, `data: <EventEnvelope JSON>`. A `stream.heartbeat` is sent every 15 s. On reconnect with Last-Event-ID the server replays missed events (retention window configurable); if the id is too old it emits `stream.resync_required` and the client must refetch affected lists.

schema.description: SSE frames whose data field is an EventEnvelope.

post.description: Demo/hackathon only. Disabled unless DEMO_MODE=true. Restores the deterministic synthetic seed. Allowed roles: system_admin.

bearerAuth.description: Replaceable auth adapter. The hackathon demo adapter issues tokens for fictional users and is not production authentication.

Provenance.description: Source provenance and freshness. All hackathon data is synthetic or simulated.

Error.description: Structured error body used by every non-2xx response.

examples.message: Unit E12 is no longer available.

User.description: Current principal. authMode=demo_adapter is NOT production authentication.

callbackNumber.description: Synthetic or masked in the demo.

examples.narrative: Synthetic: smoke visible from second-floor window, caller reports a person trapped.

isSynthetic.description: Must be true during the hackathon.

mockScenarioId.description: Demo only: tags the incident with a scripted scenario (e.g. 'A', 'B') for reproducible demonstrations.

version.description: Expected current version; mismatch yields 409 CONFLICT.

Classification.description: Inferred and dispatcher-confirmed classifications are separate records.

ClassificationCreate.description: mode=infer asks the backend to run inference; confirm/reject records a human decision.

Recommendation.description: Decision support only. Never an autonomous dispatch order.

limitations: ETA model trained on synthetic data

overrideReason.description: Required when selecting an ineligible or lower-ranked unit.

RecommendationReview.description: simulatedAssignment is always true: no CAD integration.

standardRefs.description: e.g. FEMA NIMS RTL, NFPA 1001, NEMSIS scope of practice.

examples: Forecasts emergency service demand, not individual behaviour. Trained/evaluated on synthetic data; not operational accuracy.
Simulated outcome under stated assumptions; not a guarantee of improved safety.

LeadershipRecommendation.description: Advisory only. Does not authorize spending, assignments, or protocol changes.

id.description: Monotonically increasing per-tenant sequence, also sent as SSE `id:` for Last-Event-ID replay.

EventEnvelope.description: Common envelope for every SSE `data:` frame. Payloads per type are in docs/event-catalog.

IdemKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdemKey.description: Client-generated key; replays return the original response.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Resume after this event id; server replays missed events or sends stream.resync_required.

Conflict.description: CONFLICT, UNIT_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, RECOMMENDATION_OUTDATED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED or STALE_DATA
